svg.title: Scale transect zones
svg.desc: Six low views across flat farmland, one per zone of the scale transect, each looking north toward a horizon over the same kind of countryside: county roads on the half-mile lines, fields in forties and eighties, farmsteads along the roads, woodlots, and water. The ground in view grows from zone to zone while each tile stays the same size, and each array sits above a strip of foreground. A0 Rooftop, about 45 meters across: panels on the south slope of a barn roof, no ground taken, with the yard in front and a pond behind. A1 Farmstead, about 150 meters across: three rows in the paddock beside the barn, with cattle, a driveway off the road, and a farm pond. A2 Commercial, about 250 meters across: the corn keeps the field and the array takes the corner at the crossroads, with a creek behind. A3 Community, about 500 meters across: some 25 acres of panels behind a sown border at the crossroads, the distribution line along the road, houses along the side road, and a stream beyond. A4 Utility, about 900 meters across: a quarter section of panels between the half-mile roads, a substation and transmission line by the road, and a river beyond. A5 Complex, about 3.8 kilometers across: panels filling quarter section after quarter section, one the assembly did not get, where a farm still stands, with a substation, a small town with its elevator, woodlots, and a lake beyond. The same farm, a white house, a red barn, and a silo behind a windbreak, appears in each view.
